column1: # Inputs whose output deliberately differs from C 16.1.0's reference build.
# Each line: input path<TAB>hash of the port's normalized -Tsvg (gv-diff e2e's hash)<TAB>issue.
# `gv-diff e2e` checks a listed input against its pinned hash instead of C's; the layout
# (`gv-diff`) and structural (`gv-diff structure`) ratchets skip it. When a change moves a
# listed output on purpose, `gv-diff e2e` prints the new hash. Adding a line takes a decision
# on the issue named; see docs/versioning.md, "What identical to C means".
# #846: where C's fused `ccw` puts a route's end in no triangle, so that C loses the edge or
# draws it straight, the port repeats the point-in-triangle test with `ccw` unfused
